candidates.title: Why Trump's AI luncheon seating chart matters: Who got the seats closest to power
candidates.excerpt: US President Donald Trump shared the seating chart for a White House AI luncheon, showing Elon Musk and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang seated beside him. The meeting also featured tech leaders, including Sundar Pichai, Mark Zuckerberg and Satya Nadella, as Trump backed AI self-policing.

candidates.title: Three grievously injured as private bus overturns in Suryapet
candidates.excerpt: Three passengers suffered grievous injuries and several others minor injuries after a private travel bus carrying 36 people lost control and overturned near Hussainabad in Suryapet district early Wednesday. Police suspect the driver may have dozed off at the wheel.
